requirements: Reject unknown/oversized IDs and require the reviewed canonical lead version.
Revalidate ACTIVE actor and owned active lead before quota reservation; repeat authority and source-version validation before score settlement.
Claim actor/org/lead/operation identity atomically with quota reservation; repeat requests must not call provider or consume twice.
Do not hold database locks during external AI call.
Persist bounded validated score/reason/action result and quota settlement atomically; stale or failed work must not overwrite new lead state.
Read-only actor-scoped recovery must rescue completed result after response loss without generating again.
Unknown provider outcome remains fenced; cancellation only fences not-yet-started operations and never claims that an in-flight provider was cancelled.
Timeout/orphan policy must exceed maxDuration and prevent late settlement; refunds release pending allowance only.
Client uses bounded validated transport, synchronous lane and durable metadata, actor/org epochs and shared quota guide including correct billing owner.
Validate model JSON instead of converting missing score to0 or accepting nonstring rationale.
Actual handler/helper, mounted client and isolated PostgreSQL race/rollback tests; no paid provider invocation.
Run full frozen gate and exact SHA deployment/public verification before calling released.
scope: Separate from current lead CRUD/import release. No source implementation or provider call in this design artifact. Existing next-action helper callers must preserve their behavior until separately verified.
